about.heading: Your seal, made from gemstone
about.body: STONE SIGNATURE helps you choose a gemstone seal online, design the seal impression, and place an order from the app. Review the material and one-of-a-kind stone listings as you find the seal that fits you.

points.title: Custom design
points.body: Turn your name into a kanji-based seal design with meaning, balance, and a personal sense of intention.

points.title: Natural gemstones
points.body: Choose the seal material while reviewing colors, patterns, and natural character unique to each stone.

points.title: Handcrafted with care
points.body: After payment and design confirmation, each custom seal is produced one by one by our partner workshop.

about.tagline: Your name. Your stone. Your signature.

howItWorks.heading: Create a one-of-a-kind seal
howItWorks.intro: Move from name selection to a saved design, gemstone choice, checkout, and delivery without losing your place.

steps.title: Choose your name and kanji
steps.body: Enter your name, review kanji candidates, and choose the characters that match your intention.

steps.title: Generate your seal design
steps.body: Pick a seal style, generate design variants, and save the version you want to keep on this device.

steps.title: Select a gemstone
steps.body: Browse one-of-a-kind stones, review details and availability, then pair a stone with your saved seal.

steps.title: Checkout and receive your seal
steps.body: Confirm shipping details, agree to the terms, complete payment through Stripe Checkout, and track the order by order number and email.

howItWorks.summaryTitle: Handcrafted with care, delivered to you.
howItWorks.summaryBody: Each seal is made to order by our partner workshop after payment and design confirmation. Production usually takes 5-10 business days, and shipping usually takes about 7-14 days after dispatch.

items.question: How is kanji selected?
items.answer: Kanji is suggested from your name, the desired meaning, and the balance of the seal design. You can review candidates before choosing the design direction.

items.question: Can I change my order after payment?
items.answer: Because each seal is custom-made, changes may not be possible after production starts. Review the design, stone, shipping details, and terms before completing payment.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: Production usually takes 5-10 business days after payment and design confirmation. Shipping usually takes about 7-14 days after dispatch.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Orders are shipped from our partner workshop in China. Customs duties, import taxes, and clearance fees may be charged on receipt and are the customer's responsibility.

items.question: Are gemstones one of a kind?
items.answer: Yes. Natural stones vary in color, pattern, and texture. These differences are part of the material and are not treated as defects.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Use Order Lookup with your order number and email address. Tracking details will appear there when shipment information is available.

privacy.intro: This app displays the privacy policy in an app-friendly format and references the official web policy for the latest legal text.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, shipping details, and order details. Saved seal designs and preview images remain on this device until you delete them.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to provide the service, process orders, communicate important updates, and improve the app experience.

sections.title: Sharing information
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers needed for payment, production, delivery, support, legal compliance, or protection of rights.

sections.title: Retention and local storage
sections.body: Order-related information is retained as required for service operation and legal obligations. Local saved designs are stored only on this device and are not synced across devices in the MVP.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, use the contact guidance in Settings or the official privacy policy page.

terms.intro: These terms summarize the conditions for using STONE SIGNATURE in the app. The official web terms remain the legal source of truth.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: The service is operated by Finite Field, K.K. Customers are deemed to agree to the terms when they complete the order process.

sections.title: Orders and contract formation
sections.body: An order is treated as received when required information is entered and the order process is completed. A sales contract is formed when payment is confirmed and an order confirmation notice is sent.

sections.title: Fees, payment, and duties
sections.body: Prices are shown on each product page. Payment is made in advance through Stripe Checkout. Customs duties, import taxes, and clearance fees may apply and are the customer's responsibility.

sections.title: Production and delivery
sections.body: Each item is made to order by our partner workshop in China. Production usually takes 5-10 business days and shipping usually takes about 7-14 days after dispatch.

sections.title: Cancellations, returns, and exchanges
sections.body: Because custom seals are made to order, cancellations, returns, and exchanges are not accepted after production starts, except for significant damage or engraving errors caused by our fault.

sections.title: Governing law and language
sections.body: The terms are governed by the laws of Japan. If translated versions differ, the Japanese version prevails.

contact.heading: We are here to help.
contact.intro: For order, shipping, payment, or app questions, use the official inquiry form or email support guidance below. Include your order number when the question is about an order.

options.title: Send an inquiry
options.body: Use the official contact form for questions about orders, shipping, returns, privacy, or account support.

options.title: Email support
options.body: If your mail app is easier, include your order number, email address used at checkout, and a short description.

options.title: Before contacting us
options.body: Order status can be checked from Order Lookup with your order number and email address.

contact.replyNote: We usually reply within 2 business days.
